rationale: Allow at most 5% growth over the measured published module; review any increase with a source and consumer impact explanation. noyalib 0.0.61 measured 634,505 raw bytes (5.96% over 0.0.60; gzip 217,783, still within 5%): the core's YAML 1.2.2 parser fixes (flow continuation indentation, document-prefix BOMs, radix and tag resolution, typed key spelling) add scanner and loader code. The raw limit rises to 640,000 bytes (6.9%). noyalib 0.0.62 measured 635,608 raw and 219,147 gzip bytes (5.06% over 0.0.60), 122 past the 5% gzip limit: the serializer now quotes every hex, octal and binary spelling so the serde_yaml profile can read its own output back. The gzip limit rises to 220,000 bytes (5.47%), 975 bytes above the previous limit.
